correctness.rationale: For sigma>0 and gamma<=1 the displayed proper quadratic V has exact derivative -x^2-(y-z)^2-(1-gamma)z^2. The strict case is negative definite. At gamma=1, LaSalle reduces the zero-derivative set x=0,y=z to the origin because xdot=y^2. For gamma>1 explicit nonzero equilibria prevent global attraction. The invariant-measure corollary follows by integrating the nonnegative defect and using invariance of support.
